name: Typed Hybrid Memory Read Router
mechanism: Classifies the memory need and searches only eligible episodic semantic relational or procedural stores before bounded fusion and abstention.
use_when: Multiple memory types have different retrieval semantics
Privacy scope and temporal validity must filter every read
avoid_when: One small store already provides sufficient recall
Routing errors would hide critical evidence without a fallback
expected_effects: Less irrelevant memory injected into context
failure_modes: Router skips the store containing the answer
Scores from incompatible retrievers are fused naively
Retrieved memory violates actor or tenant scope
required_evals: equal-budget raw-log BM25 temporal and local-expansion control
exact-identifier fact-tracking multi-hop and event-order slices
